question: Should this issue be satisfied by the `sessions.list`-based dashboard `builtin:agent-status` in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101826, or should it wait for the richer `sessions.activity.*` contract tracked in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/39127?
rationale: The current PR is a plausible dashboard-widget slice, but the issue asks for current task and run progress while the broader Gateway activity/attention semantics remain unsettled.

options.title: Accept the widget slice after PR blockers
options.body: Treat the linked PR as the presentation-layer implementation once its proof, refresh, dependency/security, and stack blockers are resolved, leaving richer activity semantics to follow-ups.

options.title: Wait for the activity contract
options.body: Keep this issue blocked until maintainers approve a canonical `sessions.activity.*` and attention-state model, then require the widget to consume that source.

options.title: Fold into the roadmap tracker
options.body: Close or narrow this issue only if maintainers decide https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/101136 should own all remaining dashboard builtin sequencing.

recommendation.title: Accept the widget slice after PR blockers
recommendation.body: Treat the linked PR as the presentation-layer implementation once its proof, refresh, dependency/security, and stack blockers are resolved, leaving richer activity semantics to follow-ups.

likelyOwner.reason: The decisive unresolved contract is the Gateway/session activity shape, and the related canonical activity issue is assigned to Vincent Koc while current status-surface history points there too.
